plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.A. in Political Science, McCausland College of Arts and Sciences, Dept. of Political Science, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_poli_map.pdf). All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (15/15/15/15/15/15/15/13 at slot minimums = 118 total; official degree minimum 120 per Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 24 major, 52-61 college/program, 35-44 Carolina Core, 2.000 GPA — range slots/electives fill to 120+). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: Carolina Core ARP (3-4) at 3; Foreign language/other CC (3-4) at 3; Carolina Core Req (3-4) at 3. Seven POLI courses at 300+ required, one of POLI 315/316/361/368/370/374/451/462/504 (CC-INT); 12-hr advanced cognate or 18+ hr minor; foreign language proficiency equivalent to the 122 course; one U.S. + one non-U.S. History required. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
